why: The canary (version 1.1) returned 10 5xx responses while the three stable pods (version 1.0) returned 0 (claim 1). All 10 canary 5xx were on /checkout (claim 2): the canary served 483 /checkout requests with 10 5xx = 2.07% errors, while stable served 1455 /checkout requests with 0 5xx (claim 3). Latency is not the issue - canary p95 is 96 ms vs stable 94 ms (claim 4). The canary 5xx are spread across all four 30 s windows, 1 / 3 / 3 / 3 (claim 5). Judgement: a ~2% failure rate on the revenue-critical checkout path, with a zero-error baseline on the same path at 3x the traffic, is directly customer-visible; because the failures continue through the final window instead of only at startup, this is judged to be a real regression in 1.1 rather than warm-up noise, so the safe call is ROLLBACK and fix /checkout before re-canarying.
